text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm suuuper happy I get to go<n>stargazing with
Ayabe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll go just about anywhere if it means<n>snapping
some cute pics. Whether it's up<n>in the mountains
or down by the beach!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's a little chilly, but I'm just fine! You<n>know,
being super cute is kinda like<n>climbing a
mountain!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe, you're such a meanie! I was really<n>looking
forward to today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега
text_block_list.text:
That bright cluster of stars is the<n>Andromeda
Galaxy. Can you see it looks<n>like an oval?

text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега
text_block_list.text:
The name "Andromeda" comes from a<n>beautiful
princess in Greek mythology.<n>She was to be
sacrificed but was saved<n>by a hero in the end.

text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега
text_block_list.text:
...You're awfully quiet now. Could you<n>not stare
at me like that?

text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why is your camera out?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The stars reflecting in your eyes looked<n>so cute.

text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега
text_block_list.text:
D-don't be stupid! Give me your phone<n>right now,
I'm deleting that!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, pleeease! I promise I won't show<n>anyone,
so can't I keep it? ♪
